_howto: All REAL. From paradisenails.com: the 'Escape the Ordinary' slogan, full address with the Olive Garden/CVS locator, contact@paradisenails.com, and hours (Mon-Fri 9-7, Sat 9-6, Sun 10-5). NOT USED: the 3.7 rating — 150 reviews is a strong volume signal but 3.7 does not help them, so the rating is left off rather than featured. 'Established 2003' came from Google's AI summary, not the business, so it is not on the page. Sister salons: Serenity Nails, UTC-La Jolla and Mira Mesa.

Paradise Nails and Spa is a family-owned salon in Grossmont Center, La Mesa — between Olive Garden and CVS, suite 426.
